tagline: 理光旁轴相机，1958 年发布
description: 理光于1958年推出的旁轴相机。配备Riken Optical Rikenon f 1.9 / 4.5cm - 6 elements in 4 groups (Made by Tomioka Optical)。快门速度Seikosha MXL, Speeds 1/10 - 1/500 sec + B。manual focusing with help of coupled rangefinder。

specs.镜头: Riken Optical Rikenon f 1.9 / 4.5cm - 6 elements in 4 groups (Made by Tomioka Optical)
specs.曝光测光: Light Value system with external light meter (The Light Value system was first adopted in Japan on the Ricoh 500)
specs.对焦: manual focusing with help of coupled rangefinder
specs.英文简介: The Ricoh 519 Deluxe (FiveOneNine) is a rangefinder camera with fixed lens made in Japan by Ricoh from 1958.
